black_hole.target: the adjacent tile in Jerv's last facing direction
black_hole.success: remove the object from the target tile and push it onto the top of the inventory stack
black_hole.empty_target: leave the inventory unchanged and show empty-target feedback

white_hole.target: the adjacent tile in Jerv's last facing direction
white_hole.success: pop the top item from the inventory stack and place it on the target tile
white_hole.empty_inventory: leave the target tile unchanged and show empty-inventory feedback
white_hole.blocked_target: if the target tile is occupied or outside the grid, keep the item on top of the inventory stack

feedback.target_tile: outline the tile Jerv is facing
feedback.inventory: show stack size and its top item above the grid
feedback.last_action: show whether the object was absorbed, expelled, or the action had no effect
